scope: Compare the normal horizontal scrollbar endpoint cells from GTK2 using the currently active user DomainOS RC and domainos-pixbuf module against native HP VUE SR10.4 at 1:1.

comparison.method: Exact RGB; 15x15 endpoint cells; no scaling or filtering. GTK2 cell origins were located in the captured widget before comparison.

limits: This closes only the normal horizontal endpoint cells in a fresh GTK2 process. It does not prove live XChat appearance by visual inspection or user acceptance.
Pressed, hover, disabled-whole-widget, thumb drag, and the direct VUE horizontal held state remain open; the latter requires the separate I517 authorization.
The companion service remains running; schema-change regeneration through that already-running process is still a separate follow-up.
next: Continue I167 GTK2 with the next state that has direct historical evidence and no extra VUE input gate; retain user visual review as pending.
